title: Design a content delivery pipeline for a global video platform.
description: Use CDN, transcoding pipeline, and origin storage for global video delivery.

data.text: **Question:** Design a content delivery pipeline for a global video platform.
Upload to origin storage, transcode to multiple bitrates, cache on edge CDNs, and use adaptive bitrate streaming for smooth playback.

items: Origin: S3 or GCS for raw uploads
Transcoding: FFmpeg or media services to HLS/DASH
Packaging: segment files and manifest generation
CDN: CloudFront or Cloudflare for edge caching
Player: adaptive bitrate switching based on bandwidth
Not invalidating cached segments after updates
How do you reduce origin egress costs?
What about live streaming vs VOD?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: CDN is critical for global latency
Origin storage should be durable and cheap
